[C] high | entire lower two-thirds of window | massive unmanaged empty region below the status line with no content, structure, or visual anchor.
[C] med | left column, ~60-440px | all content is crowded into a narrow left strip while ~70% of the canvas to the right of the setup card is dead space.
[L] low | setup card region | card width fits content tightly but the two status cards below have different widths, creating a ragged left-aligned column edge.
[S] low | buttons row (~y340) | gap between "Run initial sync" and "Mark complete" buttons differs from the vertical gaps between blocks above/below, breaking vertical rhythm.
[H] med | subtitle line (~y59) | long explanatory sentence in near-body-size gray text competes with the checklist descriptions for equal visual weight, diluting hierarchy.
[H] low | status card (~y390-420) | two full sentences of gray status/debug-style text ("Onboarding is not marked complete yet." / "No Help Scout credentials yet…") sit at equal weight with no heading or severity cue.
[V] low | footer status line (~y475) | raw diagnostic string "setup 1/3 steps complete · 1 conversation in the local mirror" reads like a debug/test harness readout rather than designed UI.
